indicator.name: Class C rural road length
indicator.description: Published total kilometres of Class C rural roads in each county in 2025 from KNBS Economic Survey 2026 Table 11.9.
indicator.expected_source: KNBS Economic Survey 2026 Table 11.9; underlying source Kenya Rural Roads Authority
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published directly for all 47 counties for 2025 provisional. This is Class C rural-road length only, not total county road-network length. Published Total values are used verbatim and are not recomputed from rounded paved/unpaved components.
